title: Binary decision trees
statement: For a natural number $n$, a type $\alpha$, and a set $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of available coordinates, a binary decision tree with available coordinates $A$ is either a leaf labeled by an element of $\alpha$, or a query at some coordinate $i\in A$ with two child trees, each having available coordinates $A\setminus\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: the available coordinates form a finite subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
